threshold_or_clearing_number: a licence or written consent naming gambling-use analytics
notes: NFL.com Terms §1.3 restricts systematic retrieval and non-informational use.

threshold_or_clearing_number: an observation timestamp earlier than kickoff and earlier than the price it is compared with
notes: Blocks look-ahead from retroactively updated injury statuses or post-kickoff snap counts.

threshold_or_clearing_number: a timestamped, de-vigged closing-line archive from a licensed provider
notes: The single biggest blocker: no official NFL page publishes a price, so market and difference columns stay blank.

threshold_or_clearing_number: parameters frozen before each week; no future information enters the fit
notes: Blocks in-sample overfitting and look-ahead.

threshold_or_clearing_number: out-of-sample Brier and reliability curve beating the reference
notes: Blocks a confident-but-wrong probability model.

threshold_or_clearing_number: a confidence interval reported beside every point estimate
notes: NIST/SEMATECH 3.5.2; a point estimate is never presented as exact.

threshold_or_clearing_number: at least 200 settled bets across at least 60 distinct slates
notes: Blocks a 6-bet run that looks like skill.

threshold_or_clearing_number: Holm / Bonferroni adjusted p < 0.05 across every strategy and market tested
notes: Blocks data-snooping across M candidate strategies.

threshold_or_clearing_number: look-back shortened or re-weighted by measured roster identity
notes: Blocks fitting season-long rates to a roster that no longer exists.

threshold_or_clearing_number: each pairwise dependence pre-registered, measured, interval excludes 0
notes: Blocks combining legs whose dependence is unmeasured.

threshold_or_clearing_number: joint probability used for pricing is the correlated one
notes: Blocks multiplying leg probabilities as if independent.

threshold_or_clearing_number: hypothesis, signal rule and thresholds committed to git before the first observation
notes: The commit hash is the registration. Currently the only gate that passes.

threshold_or_clearing_number: a signed commercial/betting licence JSON verified on disk
notes: Zero unlicensed scraping of NFL.com.

threshold_or_clearing_number: feature_ts < bet_ts <= kickoff_ts - 5400s
notes: Blocks hindsight leakage from retroactively updated statuses.

threshold_or_clearing_number: strict expanding TimeSeriesSplit by NFL week; 2026 Dynamic Kickoff + 10-min OT modelled
notes: Blocks structural bias from pooling pre-2025 rules.

threshold_or_clearing_number: N >= 250 settled singles or N >= 400 combos across >= 18 slate weeks
notes: Blocks small-sample coin-flip heaters.

threshold_or_clearing_number: p_win + p_loss + p_push == 1 on integer margins 3/7/6/10/14 and OT ties
notes: Blocks continuous-CDF errors that misvalue half-points.

threshold_or_clearing_number: holdout Brier(model) < Brier(closing_devig) AND LogLoss(model) < LogLoss(closing_devig)
notes: Blocks uncalibrated longshot picking that profits from one lucky parlay.

threshold_or_clearing_number: mean same-line de-vigged CLV > 0 with week-clustered t >= 2.50
notes: Blocks post-snap turnover luck masquerading as skill.

threshold_or_clearing_number: 95% week-block bootstrap CI lower bound strictly > 0.0, n_resamples >= 4000
notes: Blocks understated IID standard errors that ignore slate correlation.

threshold_or_clearing_number: Bonferroni / Holm adjusted p < 0.05 across M >= 10 trials
notes: Blocks p-hacking across candidate strategies.

threshold_or_clearing_number: 4-way reconciliation of injury report, club depth tiers, PS elevations, 47/48 OL rules
notes: Blocks blindly trusting unofficial club depth charts or ignoring roster turnover.

threshold_or_clearing_number: positive-definite training-only residual correlation matrix (Cholesky pivot > 1e-12)
notes: Independence is banned for combo pricing.

threshold_or_clearing_number: SHA-256 observation digest bound before kickoff
notes: Blocks retroactive deletion and window cherry-picking.

threshold_or_clearing_number: n_legs_graded_excluding_pushes >= 20
notes: A coefficient on a handful of games is a story, not a measurement.

threshold_or_clearing_number: line must not be worse_than_naive_baseline_on_at_least_one_market
notes: A line less accurate than the constant is noise with branding.

threshold_or_clearing_number: hit_rate CI95 high >= break-even probability implied by the quoted price
notes: The interval must at least touch break-even.

threshold_or_clearing_number: abs_calibration_gap <= 0.08
notes: An overconfident model will be over-bet by every downstream staking rule.

threshold_or_clearing_number: edge_retention_ratio_last_two_weeks >= 0.50
notes: If the quoted margin collapsed to half, the inputs stopped carrying information.

threshold_or_clearing_number: max_drawdown_units <= 8.0
notes: Declared risk budget for a reference line.

threshold_or_clearing_number: mean_half_kelly_stake_fraction <= 0.25
notes: A staking rule sizing more than a quarter of the bank means overconfident probabilities.

threshold_or_clearing_number: price_chain_breaks == 0
notes: A broken hash chain means the sequence is not the one that was written.

threshold_or_clearing_number: standings_reconciliation_mismatches == 0
notes: Every fair line is built from the standings feed.

threshold_or_clearing_number: results_feed_identity_failures == 0
notes: sum(W)==sum(L) and the like make the feed a feed, not a transcription.
